---
title: "GO enrichment analysis of RSMod module 49"
output: html_document
---

This R Markdown file reproduces the Gene Ontology (GO) enrichment analysis
performed for genes assigned to RSMod module 49.

The analysis tests GO Biological Process (BP) terms using the `topGO` package
with the `elim` algorithm and Fisher's exact test. GO terms containing fewer
than 10 annotated genes are excluded (`nodeSize = 10`).

## Required input files

- `filtered-uniqGO.map`: gene-to-GO mapping file used to define the annotation
  and background gene universe.
- `cluster49_list.txt`: one-column text file containing the gene IDs assigned
  to module 49.

Both files should be placed in the working directory together with this Rmd
file, or the file paths below should be changed accordingly.

## Main output files

- `Module49_topGO_BP_top100.tsv`: top 100 enriched GO Biological Process terms.
- `Module49_topGO_BP_gene_table.tsv`: genes associated with each of the reported
  GO terms, including module 49 genes.
- `cluster49_topGO_BP_bubble.eps`: bubble plot of the top 10 GO terms ranked by
  enrichment p-value.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(topGO)
library(ggplot2)
library(grid)
library(stringr)

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

## GO enrichment analysis

```{r enrichment}
## =========================================================
## INPUT DATA
## =========================================================

# Read the gene-to-GO mapping used to define the annotated gene universe.
geneID2GO <- readMappings(
  file = "filtered-uniqGO.map",
  sep = "\t",
  IDsep = ","
)

geneNames <- names(geneID2GO)

# Read the module 49 gene list (one gene ID per line).
cl49 <- read.delim(
  "cluster49_list.txt",
  header = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)$V1

cl49 <- trimws(cl49)
cl49 <- cl49[cl49 != ""]

# Report basic input statistics.
cat("Annotated background genes:", length(geneNames), "\n")
cat("Genes in module 49 input list:", length(cl49), "\n")
cat(
  "Module 49 genes represented in the GO background:",
  sum(cl49 %in% geneNames),
  "\n"
)


## =========================================================
## DEFINE THE topGO GENE UNIVERSE
## =========================================================

# Assign 1 to module 49 genes and 0 to all other genes in the annotated
# background. The complete set of genes in geneID2GO is therefore used as
# the background gene universe.
geneList <- factor(
  as.integer(geneNames %in% cl49)
)

names(geneList) <- geneNames


## =========================================================
## topGO ANALYSIS
## =========================================================

# Biological Process ontology; GO terms with fewer than 10 annotated genes
# are excluded.
GOdata <- new(
  "topGOdata",
  ontology = "BP",
  allGenes = geneList,
  annot = annFUN.gene2GO,
  gene2GO = geneID2GO,
  nodeSize = 10
)

# GO enrichment using the elim algorithm and Fisher's exact test.
resultFis <- runTest(
  GOdata,
  algorithm = "elim",
  statistic = "fisher"
)


## =========================================================
## EXPORT ENRICHED GO TERMS
## =========================================================

# Retrieve the top 100 GO terms ranked by enrichment p-value.
goEnrichment <- GenTable(
  GOdata,
  P_value = resultFis,
  orderBy = "P_value",
  topNodes = 100,
  numChar = 1000
)

goEnrichment$P_value <- as.numeric(goEnrichment$P_value)

# Retrieve annotated genes and module 49 genes for each reported GO term.
goList <- goEnrichment$GO.ID

gene_table <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    goList,
    function(goid) {

      annots <- genesInTerm(GOdata, goid)[[1]]
      sigs <- annots[annots %in% sigGenes(GOdata)]

      data.frame(
        GO.ID = goid,
        Term = goEnrichment$Term[
          match(goid, goEnrichment$GO.ID)
        ],
        Annotated = length(annots),
        Significant = length(sigs),
        AnnotatedGenes = paste(
          annots,
          collapse = ";"
        ),
        Module49_Genes = paste(
          sigs,
          collapse = ";"
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

write.table(
  goEnrichment,
  "Module49_topGO_BP_top100.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  gene_table,
  "Module49_topGO_BP_gene_table.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

## Bubble plot of the top enriched GO terms

The plot displays the 10 GO Biological Process terms with the lowest
enrichment p-values. Gene Ratio is calculated as the number of module 49 genes
associated with a GO term (`Significant`) divided by the number of background
genes annotated to that term (`Annotated`). Point size represents the number of
module 49 genes, and fill represents `-log10(p-value)`.

```{r bubble-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
ntop <- min(10, nrow(goEnrichment))

goPlot <- goEnrichment[
  seq_len(ntop),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

goPlot$P_value <- as.numeric(
  goPlot$P_value
)

goPlot$Significant <- as.numeric(
  goPlot$Significant
)

goPlot$Annotated <- as.numeric(
  goPlot$Annotated
)

# Wrap long GO term labels.
goPlot$Term_wrap <- str_wrap(
  goPlot$Term,
  width = 35
)

# Arrange terms by p-value in the plotted order.
goPlot$Term_wrap <- factor(
  goPlot$Term_wrap,
  levels = rev(goPlot$Term_wrap)
)

p <- ggplot(
  goPlot,
  aes(
    x = Term_wrap,
    y = Significant / Annotated,
    size = Significant,
    fill = -log10(P_value)
  )
) +
  expand_limits(y = 1) +
  geom_point(shape = 21) +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 15)) +
  scale_fill_continuous(
    low = "royalblue",
    high = "red4"
  ) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Gene Ratio") +
  labs(
    title = "GO Biological Processes",
    subtitle = "Module 49: top 10 terms ranked by p-value"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
  ylim(0, 0.2) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.background = element_rect(),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    legend.key = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    )
  ) +
  coord_flip()

ggsave(
  "cluster49_topGO_BP_bubble.eps",
  plot = p,
  device = "eps",
  height = 160,
  width = 180,
  units = "mm"
)
```

## Reproducibility notes

- The annotated genes present in `filtered-uniqGO.map` define the background
  gene universe.
- Module 49 genes are tested against this background.
- Ontology: Biological Process (`BP`).
- Algorithm: `elim`.
- Statistical test: Fisher's exact test.
- Minimum GO term size: 10 annotated genes (`nodeSize = 10`).
- The reported p-values are the `topGO` elim/Fisher p-values. No additional
  multiple-testing adjustment is applied in this script.

```{r session-info}
sessionInfo()
```
